sections.title: A third size, and a word for "too"
sections.content: You already know kicsi ("small") and nagy ("large") from A1. közepes ("medium") completes the set. túl ("too, excessively") goes right before an adjective, exactly like English — túl nagy ("too big"), túl drága ("too expensive").

items.english: What size are you looking for?

items.spanish: Kicsi, közepes vagy nagy méretet keresek.
items.english: I'm looking for a small, medium, or large size.

items.spanish: Ez túl nagy, az túl kicsi.
items.english: This one is too big, that one is too small.

sections.content: túl works with any adjective you already know, not just sizes — túl drága, túl messze, túl fáradt all follow the same pattern.
